cards.title: Last Slice
cards.scenario: There's one slice of pizza left and three people want it. What do you do?
cards.twist: You learn that whoever eats it has to clean up the entire kitchen.

cards.title: Movie Night
cards.scenario: You pick tonight's movie.
cards.twist: You win $20 if everyone watches to the credits.

cards.title: Snack Supply
cards.scenario: You can have one snack delivered free every day for a year. Which do you choose?
cards.twist: The delivery always arrives right before bedtime, and you can't save it for later.

cards.title: Perfect Seat
cards.scenario: Where do you sit at the movies?
cards.twist: Your best friend refuses that section.

cards.title: Food Forever
cards.scenario: Give up one forever.
cards.twist: The other two become free for life.

cards.title: Theme Park
cards.scenario: Skip the line for one attraction.
cards.twist: You must ride it three times.

cards.title: Friends Over
cards.scenario: You're hosting friends for the evening. What's the plan?
cards.twist: One guest brings along someone none of you know, and you're responsible for making them feel included.

cards.title: Perfect Breakfast
cards.scenario: Choose a breakfast prepared perfectly.
cards.twist: You must eat it daily for a month.

cards.title: TV Control
cards.scenario: You control the television all weekend.
cards.twist: Everyone at home must watch with you.

cards.title: Birthday Dessert
cards.scenario: Pick your birthday dessert.
cards.twist: You must make it yourself with no recipe.

cards.title: Long Drive
cards.scenario: Six hours in a car. How do you pass the time?
cards.twist: You must keep the driver entertained.

cards.title: Arcade Pass
cards.scenario: You get unlimited plays on one arcade machine for an afternoon. Which do you choose?
cards.twist: You can keep every prize you win, but you must beat your own high score before leaving.

cards.title: Party Playlist
cards.scenario: You control the party music.
cards.twist: You must perform with every song.

cards.title: Mystery Package
cards.scenario: A surprise package arrives for you. What would you most like to find inside?
cards.twist: You can keep it only if you correctly guess who sent it before opening the card.

cards.title: Big Screen
cards.scenario: You get a giant screen for an evening.
cards.twist: You must invite 20 people.

cards.title: Lunch Trade
cards.scenario: Someone offers to swap their lunch for yours. What would make you agree?
cards.twist: You learn the other person packed your favorite food, but you must decide before seeing which option it is.

cards.title: Water Park
cards.scenario: Have one attraction to yourself.
cards.twist: You have only ten minutes.

cards.title: Weekend Choice
cards.scenario: Pick your ideal weekend.
cards.twist: You cannot spend any money.

cards.title: Prize Wheel
cards.scenario: A prize wheel lets you choose one reward. What do you pick?
choices: Your favorite food free for a year
cards.twist: You may keep the prize, but the person sitting to your left chooses who shares it with you.

cards.title: Dinner Vote
cards.scenario: Your group asks you to choose dinner. What do you pick?
cards.twist: The restaurant you choose will be the only place your group can eat together for the next month.

cards.title: The Mystery Envelope
cards.scenario: Three sealed envelopes contain a surprise. Which clue do you trust?
cards.twist: You discover you must give the entire prize to someone else, but you get to choose who.

cards.title: Secret Keeper
cards.scenario: A friend shares a harmless embarrassing secret.
cards.twist: They tell everyone tomorrow anyway.

cards.title: One Invitation
cards.scenario: Pick one event.
cards.twist: Your friend says your presence matters most.

cards.title: New Person
cards.scenario: Someone new joins your group.
cards.twist: They're extremely shy.

cards.title: Harmless Prank
cards.scenario: Friends plan a harmless prank. Your role?
cards.twist: The target has had a terrible day.

cards.title: Competition Partner
cards.scenario: Pick a partner for a two-person contest.
cards.twist: You must swap roles without speaking.

cards.title: Group Chat
cards.scenario: Nobody agrees on an outing. You...
cards.twist: The outing is tomorrow and nobody replied.

cards.title: Making Up
cards.scenario: You accidentally upset a friend. How apologize?
cards.twist: They leave for a week in five minutes.

cards.title: Unpopular Opinion
cards.scenario: Everyone disagrees with your harmless opinion.
cards.twist: Someone secretly agrees.

cards.title: Surprise Party
cards.scenario: Pick a party-planning job.
cards.twist: The guest of honor hates surprises.

cards.title: Lost Wallet
cards.scenario: You find a wallet. First move?
cards.twist: You spot the owner leaving.

cards.title: Unexpected Compliment
cards.scenario: Someone compliments you publicly.
cards.twist: They repeat it through a microphone.

cards.title: The Unexpected Day Off
cards.scenario: You wake up to an entire surprise day off. What's your first move?
choices: Go somewhere you've wanted to visit
Stay home and enjoy the freedom
cards.twist: You get a message saying everyone you know also has the day off.

cards.title: Big Favor
cards.scenario: A friend asks for help on your free afternoon.
cards.twist: They secretly helped you last week.

cards.title: Funny Photo
cards.scenario: A friend posts a silly photo of you.
cards.twist: Strangers start sharing it.

cards.title: Game Night Rule
cards.scenario: Pick a permanent game-night rule.
cards.twist: You must follow it for a year.

cards.title: Honest Haircut
cards.scenario: A friend asks if you like their haircut. You don't.
cards.twist: They're getting it again tomorrow.

cards.title: Old Friend
cards.scenario: A friend you haven't seen in years arrives.
cards.twist: They leave town in an hour.

cards.title: Last Pick
cards.scenario: One person is left when choosing teams.
cards.twist: They're secretly the best player.

cards.title: Invisible Day
cards.scenario: You can be invisible for a day.
cards.twist: You can't turn it off until midnight.

cards.title: Teleport Once
cards.scenario: Teleport anywhere once today.
cards.twist: You must get home normally.

cards.title: Mind Reading
cards.scenario: Read one person's thoughts for ten minutes.
cards.twist: They hear your thoughts too.

cards.title: Time Window
cards.scenario: Visit one moment in time.
cards.twist: You can watch but not interact.

cards.title: Pause Time
cards.scenario: Pause time for one hour.
cards.twist: You lose an hour of sleep tonight.

cards.title: Magic Skill
cards.scenario: Choose a permanent ability.
cards.twist: People can ask you to use it anytime.

cards.title: Future Letter
cards.scenario: Your future self sends a letter.
cards.twist: You must read it aloud to everyone.

cards.title: Your Double
cards.scenario: A duplicate of you exists for a day.
cards.twist: You remember everything they did.

cards.title: Understand Anything
cards.scenario: Choose a communication power.
cards.twist: You must translate for strangers weekly.

cards.title: Memory Replay
cards.scenario: Relive one memory perfectly.
cards.twist: Everyone involved watches too.

cards.title: Magic Door
cards.scenario: Your bedroom door can open to one place.
cards.twist: It stays open only 30 minutes.

cards.title: Future Meeting
cards.scenario: Meet future you. Ask about...
cards.twist: They ask one question you must answer honestly.

cards.title: Weather Control
cards.scenario: Control one day's weather.
cards.twist: Your whole town gets it.

cards.title: Instant Expert
cards.scenario: Master one skill overnight.
cards.twist: You compete against a professional tomorrow.

cards.title: Do Over
cards.scenario: Redo one moment from last year.
cards.twist: Everyone remembers the first version.

cards.title: Secret Hideout
cards.scenario: Pick a private hideout.
cards.twist: You must share it forever with one person.

cards.title: Dream Night
cards.scenario: Control one vivid dream.
cards.twist: You remember it like real life.

cards.title: Instant Task
cards.scenario: One everyday task can be done instantly forever. Which would you pick?
choices: Traveling to places you go often
cards.twist: The shortcut works only when you're completely alone.

cards.title: Lucky Coin
cards.scenario: A coin guarantees success once. Use it for...
cards.twist: Everyone knows you're using it.

cards.title: Borrow Talent
cards.scenario: Borrow one person's talent for a day.
cards.twist: They borrow one of your skills too.

cards.title: Three Doors
cards.scenario: Choose a free experience.
cards.twist: Your companion chooses the date.

cards.title: Dream Vacation
cards.scenario: Choose a free five-day trip.
cards.twist: Leave tomorrow with one backpack.

cards.title: Overnight Adventure
cards.scenario: Pick somewhere to sleep.
cards.twist: Your roommate is a surprise.

cards.title: Big Race
cards.scenario: Enter one contest.
cards.twist: Your partner has never tried it.

cards.title: Hidden Trail
cards.scenario: What do you hope is at the end of a trail?
cards.twist: You may explore only at night with a guide.

cards.title: VIP Pass
cards.scenario: Choose a VIP experience.
cards.twist: Bring someone who's never been.

cards.title: Mystery Trip
cards.scenario: What detail matters most before a surprise trip?
cards.twist: The planner refuses to reveal it.

cards.title: Island Week
cards.scenario: Pick an island vacation.
cards.twist: No internet or phone service.

cards.title: Snow Day
cards.scenario: Unexpected snow day. Choose.
cards.twist: Snow melts by noon.

cards.title: Guided Challenge
cards.scenario: Pick an outdoor challenge.
cards.twist: Your closest friend is scared but wants to join.

cards.title: Live Show
cards.scenario: Pick a live performance.
cards.twist: You attend alone in the front row.

cards.title: Sports Talent
cards.scenario: Be great at one sport for a year.
cards.twist: You must coach beginners every weekend.

cards.title: The Secret Ingredient
cards.scenario: You're in a friendly cooking contest. Which dish would you attempt?
cards.twist: Five minutes before judging, you learn the judges will taste it blindfolded and you cannot explain what you made.

cards.title: World Record
cards.scenario: Break one world record.
cards.twist: Someone challenges it tomorrow.

cards.title: Final Point
cards.scenario: You're one point from winning.
cards.twist: A younger player is about to win for the first time.

cards.title: Talent Show
cards.scenario: Enter a talent contest.
cards.twist: Perform with someone you barely know.

cards.title: Trivia Lifeline
cards.scenario: You're on a quiz show and can choose one lifeline for the final question.
choices: Get an extra minute to think
cards.twist: The question is worth double points, but using any lifeline means you must split the prize with a stranger.

cards.title: Big Wager
cards.scenario: Risk all your points on a challenge.
cards.twist: Opponent chooses difficulty.

cards.title: Team Look
cards.scenario: Pick a team uniform.
cards.twist: Wear it everywhere all weekend.

cards.title: Comeback Plan
cards.scenario: Your team is losing badly.
cards.twist: Opponents offer you one rule change.

cards.title: The Best Seat in the House
cards.scenario: You win two front-row tickets. What would you rather see?
cards.twist: The second ticket must go to someone who doesn't like your chosen event.

cards.title: Award Choice
cards.scenario: Pick an award.
cards.twist: Give a speech proving you deserve it.

cards.title: Impossible Puzzle
cards.scenario: One hour to solve a puzzle.
cards.twist: Only one person gets the prize.

cards.title: Shopping Spree
cards.scenario: Five free minutes in a store.
cards.twist: Everything must fit in a backpack.

cards.title: Mystery Gift
cards.scenario: Who picks your surprise gift?
cards.twist: You must give them a gift immediately too.

cards.title: Treasure Chest
cards.scenario: What do you hope to find?
cards.twist: Give it away after a week.

cards.title: Hundred Dollar Kindness
cards.scenario: You have $100 to make someone's day. Who gets the surprise?
cards.twist: You discover the person you choose must decide whether to keep the gift or pass it on to someone else.

cards.title: Free Store
cards.scenario: Choose a store for ten free minutes.
cards.twist: Keep only what you carry without a bag.

cards.title: Prize Giveaway
cards.scenario: Pick a prize.
cards.twist: Give it to someone else in the room.

cards.title: Borrowed Favorite
cards.scenario: Borrow something from a friend for a month.
cards.twist: They borrow one of your things too.

cards.title: Free Year
cards.scenario: Get one thing free for a year.
cards.twist: Use it every week.

cards.title: Help a Cause
cards.scenario: Donate a big prize to one cause.
cards.twist: Volunteer there every month.

cards.title: Giant Box
cards.scenario: Pick a mystery box label.
cards.twist: Whatever is inside needs two people.

cards.title: Birthday Budget
cards.scenario: Spend $200 on your birthday.
cards.twist: All friends are busy that day.

cards.title: Save One Thing
cards.scenario: Save one category of belongings from a harmless flood.
cards.twist: Everything else can be replaced free.

cards.title: Three Invitations
cards.scenario: Who gets your one free day?
cards.twist: One planned a special surprise.

cards.title: Daily Upgrade
cards.scenario: Choose one life upgrade.
cards.twist: It lasts only one month starting tomorrow.

cards.title: New Tradition
cards.scenario: Pick a new family tradition.
cards.twist: You must organize every time.

cards.title: Public Mistake
cards.scenario: You make a small embarrassing mistake in public.
cards.twist: Someone asks to post the video online.

cards.title: Someone Alone
cards.scenario: Someone sits alone at an event.
cards.twist: Their friend never showed up.

cards.title: Quick Reunion
cards.scenario: An old friend appears.
cards.twist: They have only 20 minutes.
